examples.summary: I call because this holding is a plausible defense at this price. Other close lines were also viable.
I check because I want to control the pot with this hand. Other close lines were also viable.
I check because I can see the next card without paying. Other close lines were also viable.
I fold because I am respecting my entry-range mix at this position and price. Other close lines were also viable.
I raise to 35 because this holding supports opening or reopening the betting. Other close lines were also viable.

I bet to 23 because my draw gives me a way to improve while applying pressure. My hand has draw coverage on this board. I took the betting lead earlier in the hand. Other close lines were also viable.
I check because the draw missed and further pressure is not compelling. Other close lines were also viable.

I bet to 10 because a supported bet can protect my made hand. My made hand has showdown value on this board. The action has checked to me. I am last to act. My earlier pot-control plan argues for restraint. Other close lines were also viable.
I bet to 10 because this is a supported thin-value opportunity. My made hand has showdown value on this board. I took the betting lead earlier in the hand. Other close lines were also viable.
I bet to 23 because the model supports a chance to win without a showdown. I took the betting lead earlier in the hand. Other close lines were also viable.

I bet to 63 because the checks give me a plausible opportunity to take the pot. The action has checked to me. I am last to act. I took the betting lead earlier in the hand. Other close lines were also viable.
I bet to 88 because I am trying to get value from weaker hands. My made hand has showdown value on this board. I took the betting lead earlier in the hand. Other close lines were also viable.
